name: Digital rain
description: Abstract screens of falling code: vertical streams of tiny glowing characters on black, bright at the head of each stream and fading behind, sometimes bending into a spiral, a wave or a tunnel.
light: the glyphs are the only light, on pure black
a soft glow and bloom around the brightest streams
a faint fog of light deep in the background
composition: all-over streams top to bottom, random lengths and speeds
a few streams in the dark, lots of black
streams bending into a spiral, wave or tunnel in depth
streams thick in the foreground, tiny in the distance
camera_or_medium: digital render, crisp glyphs, shallow depth of field on the nearest streams
texture_detail: tiny made-up characters (not real letters or words), each stream with one white-hot head and a fading tail, subtle scan lines, soft bloom
subjects: green streams of glyphs falling on black
blue code rain fading into fog
streams curving into a slow spiral
a tunnel of falling characters seen from inside
